1000:0302.name: rtl_lxmul
1000:0302.note: Borland RTL 32-bit multiply: DX:AX * CX:BX -> DX:AX (low 32 bits)

1000:033a.name: rtl_scopy
1000:033a.note: Borland RTL far struct copy: CX bytes from far [BP+6] to far [BP+0xa], callee pops 8

1000:0488.name: rtl_lxlsh
1000:0488.note: Borland RTL 32-bit shift left of DX:AX by CL

1000:04a9.name: rtl_lxrsh
1000:04a9.note: Borland RTL 32-bit arithmetic shift right of DX:AX by CL

1000:04c9.name: rtl_lxursh
1000:04c9.note: Borland RTL 32-bit logical shift right of DX:AX by CL

1000:06fc.name: rtl_setbuf
1000:06fc.note: setbuf: full buffering of 512 bytes with the given buffer, unbuffered when it is null

1000:0a3e.name: rtl_fclose
1000:0a3e.note: fclose: flushes, closes the DOS handle, resets the FILE; -1 for an unused FILE

1000:0cff.name: rtl_fopen
1000:0cff.note: fopen(name, mode): takes a free FILE and opens it; returns the FILE pointer or 0

1000:0df7.name: rtl_fread
1000:0df7.note: fread(buf, size, count, file): returns whole items read

1000:0ea1.name: rtl_fseek
1000:0ea1.note: fseek(file, offsetLo, offsetHi, whence): drops buffered data, returns 0 or -1

1000:0f0b.name: rtl_ftell
1000:0f0b.note: ftell(file): DOS position corrected by buffered bytes, in DX:AX

1000:0f5a.name: rtl_fwrite
1000:0f5a.note: fwrite(buf, size, count, file): returns whole items written

1000:1041.name: rtl_fgetc
1000:1041.note: fgetc(file): next byte, or 0xFFFF at end or on error

1000:11d0.name: rtl_memcpy
1000:11d0.note: Borland RTL near memcpy(dst, src, count): copies words, then the odd byte; returns dst

1000:121a.name: rtl_memset
1000:121a.note: Borland RTL near memset(dst, byte, count) through 1000:11f2; returns dst

1000:144d.name: rtl_fputc
1000:144d.note: fputc(byte, file): returns the byte, or 0xFFFF on error

1000:197e.name: rtl_stricmp
1000:197e.note: stricmp(a, b): string compare that folds a..z to upper case

1000:19dc.name: rtl_strncpy
1000:19dc.note: strncpy(dst, src, n): copies up to n bytes and pads the rest with zeros

1000:229c.name: rtl_malloc
1000:229c.note: malloc(size): LocalAlloc with LMEM_FIXED, no zeroing

1008:0000.name: platform_winMain
1008:0000.note: WinMain: /c opens the config dialog, /s runs the saver, any other arg shows dialog 0x6d and then runs; registers the window class, creates a full-screen window, posts WM_USER, runs the message loop

1008:0221.name: platform_defScreenSaverProc
1008:0221.note: Default message handling: mouse move over 3 px, clicks, key down, or deactivation request exit; WM_DESTROY posts quit; then DefWindowProc

1008:0c5c.name: platform_loadSettings
1008:0c5c.note: Reads all SCRANTIC.INI keys (Background, Clouds, Waves, Sounds, NumDays, CurrentYear, StartTime, ...) into globals

1008:0dc8.name: platform_saveSettings
1008:0dc8.note: Writes the same SCRANTIC.INI keys back with WritePrivateProfileString

1008:0fcd.name: platform_screenSaverProc
1008:0fcd.note: Exported window procedure: create loads settings and starts a 50 ms timer, destroy saves settings, paint blits the offscreen image, timer runs timer callbacks and the idle callback, WM_USER checks free memory then runs init

1008:12eb.name: platform_setDialogStartTime
1008:12eb.note: Normalizes an HHMM start time (wraps at 24:00 with a beep, snaps to :00 or :30), stores it, and shows it in dialog item 0x6e

1008:13cd.name: platform_pumpInputMessage
1008:13cd.note: Peeks one pending keyboard or mouse message and dispatches it, with a busy flag set meanwhile

1008:143c.name: platform_initSaver
1008:143c.note: Startup: reads RESOURCE.MAP, sets 640x480, loads JOHNCAST.PAL, shows INTRO.SCR, registers a timer callback, draws the island, loads JOHNWALK, sets the cleanup and idle callbacks

1008:15c8.name: story_idleTick
1008:15c8.note: Idle callback: runs one scene step, then updates elapsed-time counters from GetCurrentTime

1010:00fc.name: story_setTtmOffset
1010:00fc.note: Sets the TTM island offset 1068:46e4/46e2 from the island position (1068:30c4 + 1, or + 0x111 when the argument is set; 1068:30c2); both 0 when 1068:30b2 is 2

1010:0136.name: story_drawIsland
1010:0136.note: First call loads HOLIDAY.BMP, BACKGRND.BMP, MRAFT.BMP; later calls draw the background (NIGHT.SCR, a random OCEAN0x.SCR from table 1068:0262, or a fill), place the island, and set up clouds and waves

1018:0000.name: walk_loadJohnWalkBmp
1018:0000.note: Loads JOHNWALK.BMP once and resets three walk-state globals

1018:06bf.name: story_stepScene
1018:06bf.note: One scene step: when the scene queue is empty builds a new one and logs New Scene; otherwise loads the entry's ADS by id and runs its tag

1018:0c62.name: ads_loadAdsById
1018:0c62.note: Looks up an ADS id in the table at 1068:166e, unloads the previous ADS when the id changes, loads and caches the file; id -2 loads from a buffer at 1068:361c

1018:1008.name: resources_diskRetryHook
1018:1008.note: Returns its argument; called by the open retry loops, does nothing

1018:1019.name: resources_openFile
1018:1019.note: Opens a resource: loose file first, else by name hash in the archive, then checks the stored name case-insensitively; returns a file slot

1018:1204.name: resources_closeFile
1018:1204.note: Closes a resource handle: frees the file slot (closing a loose file) or fcloses a plain FILE

1018:1287.name: resources_readFile
1018:1287.note: fread-like read from an open resource file: buffer, item size, count, handle; returns items read

1018:1398.name: resources_seekFile
1018:1398.note: fseek-like seek on an open resource file: handle, 32-bit offset, whence

1018:1475.name: resources_tellFile
1018:1475.note: ftell-like position of an open resource file, returned in DX:AX

1018:14cc.name: resources_rewindFile
1018:14cc.note: Seeks a resource handle to position 0

1018:14e9.name: resources_getFileByte
1018:14e9.note: getc-like read of one byte from an open resource file, 0xFFFF at end

1018:15d2.name: resources_eofFile
1018:15d2.note: feof-like: archived resource at or past its size, or the runtime end-of-file flag

1018:1637.name: resources_writeFile
1018:1637.note: fwrite-like: archived resources write nothing and return 0; loose files go to fwrite

1018:16b7.name: resources_putFileByte
1018:16b7.note: fputc-like: archived resources return -1; loose files go to fputc

1018:1720.name: resources_setFileBuffer
1018:1720.note: setbuf-like: no-op for archived resources; loose files go to setbuf

1018:1771.name: resources_readResourceMap
1018:1771.note: Reads RESOURCE.MAP once: header, then per archive a 13-byte name and a list of 8-byte entries into a table at 1068:3365

1018:18d2.name: resources_freeResourceMap
1018:18d2.note: Frees every archive entry table and marks the map as not loaded

1018:1947.name: resources_forceArchiveReopen
1018:1947.note: Sets the flag that makes the next open reopen the archive file

1018:195a.name: resources_hashName
1018:195a.note: Uppercases a name in place, drops any path, and hashes 4 bytes at the map positions plus sum*xor into globals

1018:1a42.name: resources_findMapEntry
1018:1a42.note: Finds a map entry by the current name hash, current archive first, and fills a file slot with archive and offset

1018:1bc3.name: resources_selectArchive
1018:1bc3.note: Makes an archive current, closing the old archive file and opening the new one in a retry loop

1018:1caf.name: resources_seekArchive
1018:1caf.note: Seeks the current archive file to an absolute position unless it is already there

1018:1cfc.name: resources_fileSlotFor
1018:1cfc.note: Maps a handle to its in-use file slot, or 0; caches the last lookup

1018:1da8.name: platform_messageBoxFromResource
1018:1da8.note: Loads a string resource, formats it with the varargs, beeps, and shows a MessageBox

1018:1e60.name: story_random
1018:1e60.note: Additive lagged-Fibonacci generator over the 56-word table at 1068:1ce8 (indices 1068:1ce4 and 1068:1ce6); returns the new word

1020:0000.name: audio_loadWaveResources
1020:0000.note: If Sounds is on, finds, loads, and locks the WAVESFX1..WAVESFX25 resources into a table

1020:0085.name: audio_closeMciDevice
1020:0085.note: If Sounds is on and an MCI device is open, sends MCI_CLOSE and clears the device id

1020:00ba.name: audio_playSound
1020:00ba.note: Plays WAVESFX sample 1..25 from memory with sndPlaySound when Sounds is on

1020:019c.name: platform_requestExit
1020:019c.note: Guarded exit: optional password dialog, then sends WM_CLOSE to the main window, or beeps on a wrong password

1020:0364.name: gfx_wipeScreen
1020:0364.note: With a DC copies it to A; with 0 runs the next of six black wipes (counter 1068:361a) centered on the window, then fills it black

1020:0512.name: gfx_wipeEllipseOut
1020:0512.note: Transition: draws growing ellipses from the rect center, pumping input after each step

1020:05a0.name: gfx_wipeRectOut
1020:05a0.note: Transition: draws growing rectangles from the rect center, pumping input after each step

1020:0637.name: gfx_wipeRightToLeft
1020:0637.note: Transition: fills the rect in 1/100-width strips from right to left

1020:0688.name: gfx_wipeLeftToRight
1020:0688.note: Transition: fills the rect in 1/100-width strips from left to right

1020:06d2.name: gfx_wipeTopToBottom
1020:06d2.note: Transition: fills the rect in 1/200-height strips from top to bottom

1020:071c.name: gfx_wipeBottomToTop
1020:071c.note: Transition: fills the rect in 1/200-height strips from bottom to top

1020:081c.name: platform_debugLog
1020:081c.note: Printf-style debug log; empty in this build (only returns DS)

1028:0000.name: resources_storedRead
1028:0000.note: Method 0 read: copies input bytes to the output unchanged until input or request runs out; reached only through the method table's zero entry

1028:0024.name: resources_rleRead
1028:0024.note: Method 1 read: control byte bit 7 clear copies control&0x7f literal bytes, set repeats the next byte control&0x7f times

1028:0072.name: resources_storedWrite
1028:0072.note: Method 0 write: sends the bytes in the I/O ring unchanged to the output

1028:00b8.name: resources_readFileToFar
1028:00b8.note: Copies n bytes from the stream's file to a far address through a 50-byte bounce buffer; ignores the chunk length

1028:0125.name: resources_streamGetByte
1028:0125.note: Next input byte of the current stream, 0xFFFF once the chunk length is consumed

1028:0185.name: resources_streamReadBytes
1028:0185.note: Reads up to n input bytes into a near buffer, cut to the rest of the chunk; returns the count

1028:022e.name: resources_rleCopyLiteral
1028:022e.note: RLE literal of n bytes: straight to the destination, or to the I/O buffer and pause when the request is shorter

1028:02b4.name: resources_rleFillRun
1028:02b4.note: RLE run of n copies of a byte: straight to the destination, or to the I/O buffer and pause when the request is shorter

1028:0331.name: resources_streamPutByte
1028:0331.note: Hands one output byte to the caller; returns 0 and buffers it when the request is already full

1028:0384.name: resources_writeCompressedByte
1028:0384.note: Write side: appends one compressed byte to the stream's file or memory buffer

1028:03d0.name: resources_selectStream
1028:03d0.note: Validates a stream id and loads its record into the codec globals; 0 for a bad id

1028:048e.name: resources_freeStream
1028:048e.note: Frees a stream's I/O buffer, far codec state, and record, and clears its slot; returns 0xFFFF

1028:04f8.name: resources_allocStreamSlot
1028:04f8.note: Takes the first free of 100 stream slots and allocates a zeroed 0x21-byte record; -1 when full

1028:0547.name: resources_initStreamMethod
1028:0547.note: Checks the method (0..2), allocates the I/O buffer and far codec state from the method table, stores the method in the flags

1028:0615.name: resources_openStream
1028:0615.note: Opens a decompression stream on a file at a chunk body; read mode takes the method byte and u32 size from the file; returns stream id 0..99 or 0xFFFF

1028:076c.name: resources_openMemoryStream
1028:076c.note: Same as resources_openStream over a far memory buffer; never called

1028:0875.name: resources_closeStream
1028:0875.note: Closes a decompression stream and frees its buffers; write mode first flushes and patches the size

1028:0951.name: resources_drainBuffered
1028:0951.note: Copies bytes left in the I/O buffer to the destination, up to the bytes still requested

1028:09ca.name: resources_decodeInto
1028:09ca.note: Drains buffered bytes, runs the method's read function, drains again; returns bytes produced

1028:0a0d.name: resources_readStream
1028:0a0d.note: Reads up to count decompressed bytes into a far buffer; returns the count produced

1028:0a4b.name: resources_writeStream
1028:0a4b.note: Write side of resources_readStream: feeds bytes to the method's write function through the I/O ring; no callers

1028:0b0a.name: resources_streamSize
1028:0b0a.note: Uncompressed size from the stream header in DX:AX, 0xFFFFFFFF for a bad id

1028:0b36.name: resources_seekStream
1028:0b36.note: Seeks in decompressed bytes by decoding and discarding, rewinding first for backward seeks; no callers

1028:0c92.name: resources_rewindStream
1028:0c92.note: Restarts a read-mode stream at body + 5 and reruns the method's read init

1028:0d44.name: resources_lzwInit
1028:0d44.note: LZW read init: zeroes the state, width 9, free code 257, suffix i = i for i < 256

1028:0e04.name: resources_lzwRead
1028:0e04.note: LZW read: decodes codes through the prefix/suffix tables and a stack, handles clear (256), pauses when the request fills

1028:0fc1.name: resources_lzwReadCode
1028:0fc1.note: Next LZW code, LSB first, from groups of width bytes; grows the width or resets it after a clear; -1 at end of chunk

1028:10cb.name: resources_rleReadMemory
1028:10cb.note: RLE read for memory streams, working directly on the far source pointer

1028:11be.name: resources_lzwWriteInit
1028:11be.note: LZW write init: resets the encoder counters, width 9, free code 257, clears the hash table

1028:1233.name: resources_lzwWrite
1028:1233.note: LZW write: hashes prefix+byte pairs, emits codes, adds entries, checks the ratio once the table is full

1028:13cf.name: resources_lzwWriteCode
1028:13cf.note: Packs one LZW code into the output group, grows or resets the width; negative code flushes

1028:155d.name: resources_lzwRatioDivide
1028:155d.note: Far wrapper around 1000:03da (Borland signed 32-bit divide) for the LZW ratio check

1028:157c.name: resources_lzwCheckRatio
1028:157c.note: LZW write: emits a clear and resets the table when the compression ratio drops

1028:1654.name: resources_lzwClearHash
1028:1654.note: Fills n LZW hash table entries with -1

1028:1698.name: resources_rleWrite
1028:1698.note: Method 1 write: encodes the I/O ring into RLE runs and literals

1028:17d8.name: gfx_callDrawSprite
1028:17d8.note: Forwards (record, x, y, flags) to gfx_drawSprite; used by the TTM sprite opcodes

1028:17fa.name: decoders_callLoadBmp
1028:17fa.note: Thunk: passes its one argument to decoders_loadBmp (1030:124a) and returns its result; called from 1040:0db0 and the TTM interpreter (1058:07cf)

1028:1813.name: decoders_callLoadScreen
1028:1813.note: Thunk: passes its one argument to decoders_loadScreen (1030:16d8) and returns its result; called only from the TTM interpreter (1058:06d3)

1028:182c.name: gfx_countBitmapRecordsThunk
1028:182c.note: Forwards one word to 1030:15fb (counts the records of a bitmap list)

1028:1845.name: gfx_freeBitmapsThunk
1028:1845.note: Forwards one word to 1030:00fe (frees a loaded bitmap)

1030:000e.name: decoders_bmpPixelBytes
1030:000e.note: Called through 1068:1e24: sums ((w + 1) / 2) * h over a bitmap record list as a u32 and zeroes its second output

1030:00fe.name: gfx_freeBitmaps
1030:00fe.note: Deletes the image, mask, and mirrored image/mask GDI objects of every record, then frees the record list

1030:0197.name: gfx_rectBitsSize
1030:0197.note: Bytes of a 4-bit bitmap of w x h with rows padded to 16 pixels

1030:01c4.name: gfx_saveRectBits
1030:01c4.note: Copies a rect of the DC at 1068:1eb6 into a caller buffer with GetBitmapBits

1030:0250.name: gfx_restoreRectBits
1030:0250.note: Puts a caller buffer back with SetBitmapBits, blits it to the DC at 1068:1eb8, marks the rect dirty

1030:02ef.name: gfx_drawLine
1030:02ef.note: Draws a line in the foreground color and marks it dirty; dirty width is wrong when x2 < x1 or y2 < y1 (uses -a-b, not a-b)

1030:03d7.name: gfx_drawSpriteStretched
1030:03d7.note: Draws an image record stretched to w x h with negative source extents for flags 1/2; reached only from TTM opcodes 0xa5X6, unused by the data

1030:04ce.name: gfx_drawTextNear
1030:04ce.note: Forwards a near string to gfx_drawText

1030:04ee.name: gfx_drawText
1030:04ee.note: TextOut of a far string at x, y with text/back colors 1068:1ea0/1ea1 and back mode from 1068:1ea2; dirty rect 8 x length by 15

1030:0765.name: gfx_loadFont
1030:0765.note: Once: adds WILLY.FON, creates the 'Willy Beamish Dialog' font (8 x 8) and selects it into the draw target

1030:07c3.name: gfx_selectFontStub
1030:07c3.note: Empty: returns 1; the TTM font and text opcodes call it with a font handle

1030:07d4.name: gfx_deleteFontStub
1030:07d4.note: Empty: returns DS; TTM opcodes 0x0090 and 0xf04f and 1050:080c call it with a font handle

1030:082c.name: platform_registerCursor
1030:082c.note: Adds a cursor of kind 0x1111, 0x2222, or 0x3333 to a growable global table; -1 and -2 mean the system arrow and wait cursors

1030:09d0.name: platform_removeCursor
1030:09d0.note: Removes a cursor from the table; 0x4444 resets the active cursor and frees the whole table

1030:0a8a.name: platform_setActiveCursor
1030:0a8a.note: Activates a table cursor; kind 0x3333 hides the system cursor, clips it to the window, and draws a software cursor

1030:1112.name: decoders_readBmpInfo
1030:1112.note: Finds BMP:INF:, reads the u16 image count, every width, then every height into 14-byte near records (+6 width, +8 height) behind a zero-terminated pointer list

1030:124a.name: decoders_loadBmp
1030:124a.note: Loads a BMP resource: records from BMP:INF:, BMP:BIN: unpacked into one far buffer, images built by 1040:0000 through 1068:2574; BMP:VGA:/BMP:AMG: layers never run; returns the record list or 0

1030:15cc.name: decoders_freeBmpInfo
1030:15cc.note: Frees a bitmap record block (the list's first entry), then the pointer list

1030:15fb.name: gfx_countBitmapRecords
1030:15fb.note: Returns the number of records before the zero terminator of a bitmap list (0 for null)

1030:1624.name: decoders_expandAmgBits
1030:1624.note: Expands 1-bit pixels into 4-bit indices 0 or 1, from the end backward so it works in place; only reached from the dead BMP:AMG: branch

1030:16d8.name: decoders_loadScreen
1030:16d8.note: Loads a SCR resource: size from SCR:DIM: (default 320x400), SCR:BIN: decoded in strips of 64 rows and blitted opaque; SCR:VGA:/SCR:AMG: layers never run

1030:199a.name: platform_farAlloc
1030:199a.note: Allocates a far block of a 32-bit size with flags; returns DX:AX

1038:0000.name: decoders_chunkReaderFor
1038:0000.note: Returns the reader record (one of 4 at 1068:414e) whose file handle equals the argument; 0 finds a free record

1038:003a.name: decoders_resetChunkReader
1038:003a.note: Clears a reader record except its handle and payload end, then rewinds the file

1038:0091.name: decoders_tagPathEquals
1038:0091.note: Compares two strings for up to n characters, stopping when both reach a NUL; 1 when equal

1038:00d2.name: decoders_saveChunkReader
1038:00d2.note: Copies the reader record of a handle into a caller buffer; returns the buffer or 0

1038:0119.name: decoders_loadChunkReader
1038:0119.note: Copies a saved reader record back over the live one and seeks the file to its position

1038:016b.name: decoders_openChunkFile
1038:016b.note: Opens a resource in mode rb on a free reader record, stores the payload end as a container; returns the handle or 0

1038:01da.name: decoders_restoreChunkReader
1038:01da.note: Failure exit of the chunk search: restores the record from the backup at 1068:425a, seeks back, returns -1

1038:0215.name: decoders_findChunk
1038:0215.note: Finds a chunk by its full tag path, forward from the current chunk; returns the body position or -1

1038:0517.name: decoders_chunkSize
1038:0517.note: Low 16 bits of the current chunk size, or -1 for an unknown handle

1038:054b.name: decoders_closeChunkFile
1038:054b.note: Frees the reader record of a handle and closes the file; 1 on success

1038:0584.name: decoders_isChunkFile
1038:0584.note: 1 when the argument is the handle of an open reader record

1038:063b.name: platform_nearFree
1038:063b.note: Frees a near block through LocalFree

1038:06a8.name: platform_nearCalloc
1038:06a8.note: Zeroed near allocation of count times size bytes

1038:06ce.name: gfx_copyRect
1038:06ce.note: Copies a rect widened to 8-pixel columns (always one column extra) from 1068:1eb6 to 1068:1eb8, skipped into A when 1068:429e is set; then presents it

1038:07e8.name: gfx_presentRect
1038:07e8.note: Copies a rect to the window (centered) when the target is A or a DC is given: from the target, or from the copy source / B when 1068:429e is set

1038:0ae4.name: gfx_drawSprite
1038:0ae4.note: Draws an image record at x, y: mask AND NOT, then image OR; flags 2 uses the pre-mirrored pair, else falls back to +2/+4 with negative StretchBlt extents (1 flips, 2 mirrors)

1038:0de1.name: gfx_rescaleSprite
1038:0de1.note: Doubles or halves a record's image and mask when its scale byte differs from 1068:2e75; never at runtime (all scale modes are 3)

1038:0e8a.name: gfx_checkDoubledBitmap
1038:0e8a.note: Reads the bits of a bitmap, its doubled copy, and a 2x StretchBlt copy, then frees them all; nothing kept (leftover test code)

1038:109e.name: gfx_doubleBitmap
1038:109e.note: Returns a copy of a one-plane bitmap twice as wide and tall; dead at runtime

1038:1485.name: gfx_halveBitmap
1038:1485.note: Returns a copy of a one-plane bitmap half as wide and tall; dead at runtime

1038:1744.name: gfx_initDisplay
1038:1744.note: Display setup: accepts color mode 0, 2, or 8, always sets color mode 1068:1ebd to 2, fails when a non-zero request differs, then sets screen size and DCs

1038:194e.name: gfx_closeDisplay
1038:194e.note: Removes the cursor and deletes the three offscreen DCs and bitmaps that exist

1038:19c7.name: gfx_rescaleDisplay
1038:19c7.note: Doubles or halves the three offscreen bitmaps to a new scale mode; never referenced

1038:1ade.name: gfx_applyClip
1038:1ade.note: Selects the clip rect (x1, y1, x2 + 1, y2 + 1) as a region into all three DCs when on, the whole screen when turned off; remembered in 1068:45a6

1038:1bd8.name: gfx_drawRect
1038:1bd8.note: Draws a rect: outline when fill is off or the rect is under 2 px, else filled (PATCOPY blit when both colors match); marks it dirty

1038:1d31.name: gfx_createColorBrush
1038:1d31.note: Solid brush for colors below 16 (or in 8-color mode), otherwise an 8x8 dither pattern brush built from the two color nibbles

1040:0000.name: gfx_buildBitmaps
1040:0000.note: For each image record: builds the mask, a 4-bit bottom-up DIB with the active palette (entry 0 black for BMPs), flips rows; pre-mirrored image/mask only for JOHNWALK.BMP with enough memory

1040:0286.name: gfx_blitPixelRows
1040:0286.note: Turns a buffer of pixel rows into a bitmap (via 1040:0000) and blits it to the offscreen DC, marking the rect dirty

1040:034e.name: gfx_noopLayerStrip
1040:034e.note: Empty function; called per strip on the SCR:VGA:/SCR:AMG: path that never runs

1040:035c.name: gfx_buildBitmapMask
1040:035c.note: Builds a 1-bit mask bitmap: bit set where the 4-bit index is not 0, left pixel in bit 7; width/8 bytes per row, stride ((w+8)/16)*2

1040:0462.name: gfx_flipPixelRows
1040:0462.note: Swaps packed pixel rows top to bottom in place ((w/2) bytes per row), so a top-down buffer fits a bottom-up DIB

1040:054e.name: gfx_mirrorPixelRows
1040:054e.note: Mirrors each packed pixel row left to right in place (byte order and nibble order); builds the pre-mirrored JOHNWALK images

1040:0688.name: gfx_drawCircle
1040:0688.note: Draws Ellipse(cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r) with the foreground pen and background brush; dirty call passes right and bottom as width and height

1040:07e6.name: platform_addTimerCallback
1040:07e6.note: Registers a far callback in a 5-slot table with an interval in base ticks

1040:089a.name: platform_runTimerCallbacks
1040:089a.note: Fires every due timer callback and advances the base tick; after a pause only resets the slot times

1040:097a.name: gfx_paletteColor
1040:097a.note: Returns the COLORREF of palette entry color % 16 (16-color mode) from the active palette 1068:25ae; blue in DX

1040:09eb.name: decoders_loadPalette
1040:09eb.note: Takes a free palette slot (1..9), finds PAL:VGA:, reads 16 (color mode 2) or 256 RGB triplets byte by byte through the level table at 1068:25b0; returns the slot pointer or 0

1040:0b08.name: gfx_selectPalette
1040:0b08.note: Makes a loaded palette slot active: allocates the active palette (slot 0, pointer at 1068:25ae) on first use and copies the slot's colors into it; 0 returns the current one

1040:0bc7.name: gfx_freePalette
1040:0bc7.note: Frees a loaded palette slot (1..9) found by its pointer and clears the slot

1040:0c13.name: gfx_paletteLevelStub
1040:0c13.note: Empty: returns DS; the TTM palette fade opcodes call it

1040:0c21.name: gfx_paletteCycleStub
1040:0c21.note: Empty: returns 0; TTM opcodes 0x0400 and 0x2402 reach it

1040:0c31.name: gfx_paletteEmptyStub
1040:0c31.note: Empty: returns DS; nothing calls it

1040:0d54.name: gfx_drawPixel
1040:0d54.note: Sets one pixel in the given color and marks it dirty

1040:0db0.name: decoders_loadBmpMatrix
1040:0db0.note: Reads a BMP:MTX: grid (u16 columns, u16 rows, u16 image indices column by column), loads the same BMP's images, and composes them into one bitmap at 1068:45f8; only TTM opcode 0xF08F calls it, and no resource has BMP:MTX:

1040:10ef.name: gfx_freeBmpMatrix
1040:10ef.note: Deletes the BMP:MTX: bitmap at 1068:45f8 and clears it

1040:1113.name: gfx_blitBmpMatrix
1040:1113.note: Blits a rect of the composed BMP:MTX: bitmap to the offscreen DC and marks it dirty

1040:1183.name: gfx_scrollBmpMatrix
1040:1183.note: Moves the matrix view (1068:45fa/45fc) by whole tiles: 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right

1048:0000.name: ads_init
1048:0000.note: Unloads every ADS slot and every TTM (1048:001b), sets up the dirty-rect pool, returns 1

1048:001b.name: ads_unloadAll
1048:001b.note: Unloads the 10 ADS slots (1048:067f), then every TTM (1050:07c6)

1048:0044.name: ttm_loadTtmWithId
1048:0044.note: Loads a TTM with 1050:0177, stores the id in record word [0], runs the page index 1050:04d6; returns the id, or 0xFFFF when the load fails

1048:0079.name: ads_loadAds
1048:0079.note: Loads an ADS resource into one of 10 slots: ADS:RES: id/name pairs, then the ADS:SCR: script data; returns slot + 1 or 0

1048:0303.name: ads_nextInstruction
1048:0303.note: Returns the far pointer past one ADS instruction, sized by the 35-entry code-segment table at 1048:0383 (0 to 4 args, 0 for any other word); null past the bytecode end

1048:040f.name: ads_sectionSceneIds
1048:040f.note: Walks one ADS section to its 0xFFFF and returns a zero-terminated near list of the distinct tag nodes (1048:0bf4) named by its 0x2000/0x2005 instructions, or 0 when there are none

1048:04fc.name: ads_indexSections
1048:04fc.note: With slot n: selects it and, on first use, indexes its sections (starts after each tag word, count = number of 0xFFFF) and per-section scene lists; with 0: restores the TTM list head of the current slot

1048:067f.name: ads_unload
1048:067f.note: Unloads ADS slot n (0 = current): its TTMs, scene lists, bytecode and record; clears the current slot when it was this one

1048:0766.name: ads_sectionBusy
1048:0766.note: Story busy check for a section tag: 1 while the section runs or starts, or while a node of its scene list plays without a self-goto

1048:0805.name: ads_setSectionState
1048:0805.note: Sets a section's state, keeping the fresh bit 8, and clears its resume pointer

1048:0874.name: ads_startSection
1048:0874.note: Story start of a section: state 3 (reset its nodes, then run) through 1048:0805

1048:08b4.name: ads_setSectionStateUnlessFresh
1048:08b4.note: Clears a section's resume pointer and sets its state, unless the state is exactly 8

1048:0920.name: ads_hideSection
1048:0920.note: State 6 (its nodes do not run) through 1048:08b4; unreferenced

1048:0940.name: ads_freezeSection
1048:0940.note: State 5 (its nodes replay without advancing) through 1048:08b4; unreferenced

1048:0960.name: ads_slotIndex
1048:0960.note: Slot argument n (0 = current) to an index, or -1 when that slot is empty

1048:0993.name: ads_restartAllSections
1048:0993.note: State 3 for every section of a slot; unreferenced

1048:09e3.name: ads_startAllSections
1048:09e3.note: State 4 for every section of a slot; unreferenced

1048:0ad9.name: ads_resetAllSections
1048:0ad9.note: State 8 for every section of a slot, then resets every node; unreferenced

1048:0b3e.name: ads_resetThread
1048:0b3e.note: Resets a thread node: palette, BMP and zone slots 0, page = tag page, no next page, colors 15, delay 0, clip on over the whole screen

1048:0bc5.name: ads_resetAllNodes
1048:0bc5.note: Resets every node of the current ADS (1048:0b3e)

1048:0bf4.name: ads_findNode
1048:0bf4.note: First node of the current ADS with a TTM id and tag, or 0

1048:0c30.name: ads_sectionResumePoint
1048:0c30.note: The section start, or just past the first word 0x0005 met before 0xFFFF

1048:0c8d.name: ads_randomWeight
1048:0c8d.note: Weight of an instruction in a random block: word +8 for 0x2000/0x2005, +2 for 0x3020, +6 otherwise

1048:0cda.name: ads_randomBlock
1048:0cda.note: Runs one weighted pick (1018:1e60) among the instructions up to 0x30FF, unless it is 0x3020; returns the pointer past 0x30FF

1048:0db6.name: ads_addScene
1048:0db6.note: 0x2005: sets a node's mode from its count argument (0 once, n > 0 n times, n < 0 until now - n) and counts the play

1048:0e6e.name: ads_holdScene
1048:0e6e.note: 0x2015: node mode 5 (replays its page, never advances)

1048:0ef2.name: ads_drawFirst
1048:0ef2.note: 0x4010: moves a node to the head of the node list

1048:0f8c.name: ads_drawLast
1048:0f8c.note: 0x4000: moves a node to the tail of the node list

1048:106b.name: ads_skipBlock
1048:106b.note: Skips forward to the 0x1500 or 0x1510 that ends a block, stepping over nested 0x13xx blocks; 0 at 0xFFFF or a 0 word

1048:118a.name: ads_whileEnd
1048:118a.note: Scans forward to the 0x1520 that ends a while block; 0 at 0xFFFF or a 0 word

1048:11db.name: ads_skipFalseBlock
1048:11db.note: Skips a block whose condition is false and runs its else part when it has one

1048:1223.name: ads_evalConditions
1048:1223.note: Evaluates a chain of conditions joined by 0x1420 (and) and 0x1430 (or) into 1068:4634; returns the pointer after the chain

1048:1519.name: ads_runInstruction
1048:1519.note: Runs one ADS instruction (44-entry table at 1048:1875); returns the next pointer, or 0 to end the block

1048:1925.name: ads_runBlock
1048:1925.note: Runs instructions until 0xFFFF, a null pointer, or an end-of-block marker; returns where it stopped

1048:196e.name: ads_advancePage
1048:196e.note: When the thread's delay is due (or 0): next due time = now + delay, clears the ran flag, moves to the next page or the goto page; returns 1, else 0

1048:19e7.name: ads_sectionIndex
1048:19e7.note: Index of the section of the current ADS whose tag word is the argument, or -1

1048:1a4b.name: ads_nextSectionTag
1048:1a4b.note: Section tag iterator: stores the next section's tag, returns 1 at the end; unreferenced

1048:1aaf.name: ads_firstSectionTag
1048:1aaf.note: Restarts the section tag iterator; unreferenced

1048:1acb.name: ads_tick
1048:1acb.note: One ADS tick: runs every active thread's current page, applies delay, goto and purge, then activates the pending palette and resets the clip

1048:1e5a.name: ads_redrawThreads
1048:1e5a.note: Re-runs the last page run of every thread of the current ADS that has one, as a replay (ran flag forced to 1, restored after), then resets the clip; no call or relocation references it

1050:0000.name: ttm_measureSlotImages
1050:0000.note: Stores the widest image of the thread's BMP slot in 1068:463c and clears 1068:463e; TTM opcode 0xb000

1050:0061.name: ttm_scrollSlotImages
1050:0061.note: Draws the BMP slot's images in a column at x = arg2, starting 1068:463e above the screen bottom and spaced by arg0, marks them dirty, adds arg1 to 463e, and raises the purge flag when none was drawn; TTM opcode 0xb013

1050:013e.name: ttm_readWord
1050:013e.note: Returns the word at a far pointer

1050:0152.name: ttm_initDirtyPool
1050:0152.note: Grows the dirty-rect pool by 100 nodes; sets 1068:2641 to 2 in color mode 12

1050:0177.name: ttm_loadTtm
1050:0177.note: Loads a TTM: PAG: page count (330 when missing), TT3: bytecode decompressed whole, appends a 0xd4-byte record with a page table of count + 1 far pointers; returns 1 or 0xFFFF

1050:03e2.name: ttm_selectTtm
1050:03e2.note: Finds the TTM record with the given id in the list at 1068:2634 and makes it current (1068:2638); returns 1, or 0 when none matches

1050:042a.name: ttm_addTagRecord
1050:042a.note: Appends a zeroed 0x3d-byte near tag node (TTM id, tag id, page) at the tail of the list at 1068:263c

1050:04a8.name: ttm_skipStringArg
1050:04a8.note: Returns the far pointer past a NUL-terminated string field, padded to an even length from the string start

1050:04d6.name: ttm_indexPages
1050:04d6.note: Builds the page table of a TTM: pages end at 0x0FF0, 0x1111 tags are recorded with their page; returns 1 when all pages are found, 0 at the end of the bytecode, 0xFFFF on arg codes 8..14

1050:074a.name: ttm_runPageChecked
1050:074a.note: Runs page n of the current TTM with 1058:040c when the page exists; returns 0 otherwise

1050:0799.name: ttm_activatePendingPalette
1050:0799.note: Makes the pending palette 1068:4646 active and clears it

1050:07c6.name: ttm_unloadAll
1050:07c6.note: Unloads every TTM (1050:080c) and frees every thread node

1050:080c.name: ttm_unload
1050:080c.note: Frees one TTM record: matrix, fonts, bitmaps (not the shared walk list), palettes, zone buffers, page table, bytecode

1050:0a6e.name: ttm_shutdown
1050:0a6e.note: Frees the dirty-rect pool and unloads every TTM; nothing references it

1050:0a85.name: ttm_markDrawn
1050:0a85.note: Marks a drawn rect dirty: B to A at ages 0 and 1, and C to B at age 0 unless 1068:27c0 is set

1050:0b31.name: ttm_screenToBackground
1050:0b31.note: Sets 1068:4640, copies all of B into C, drops the C-to-B dirty list

1050:0b74.name: ttm_copyToBackground
1050:0b74.note: Copies a rect of B into C, keeping the copy source and draw target

1058:0000.name: ttm_soundOpcode
1058:0000.note: Dispatches 0xCxxx opcodes: 0xc051 plays a sample, the rest reach return-0 stubs or copy strings

1058:0144.name: ttm_drawOpcode
1058:0144.note: Dispatches 0xAxxx opcodes to the primitives, sprites, effects (1058:1510) and text

1058:040c.name: ttm_runPage
1058:040c.note: Runs one TTM page until 0x0FF0: frames each instruction, applies offsets, dispatches, marks drawings dirty

1058:13a9.name: ttm_pageOfTag
1058:13a9.note: Returns the first page whose first instruction is 0x1101 or 0x1111 with the tag, or 0xFFFF; stops at the first unset page table entry

1058:141f.name: ttm_copyStringArg
1058:141f.note: Copies a string argument (or n bytes when n is not 0) into 1068:464a, terminates it, and returns it; copies nothing when n is at least the screen height

1058:147a.name: ttm_fontSlotPointer
1058:147a.note: Returns a pointer to the thread's font handle in the TTM record (+0x18)

1058:14a8.name: ttm_paletteRangeEffect
1058:14a8.note: Calls the empty 1040:0c21 for a color range stored by opcodes 0x2302..0x2322

1058:14e0.name: ttm_surfaceByNumber
1058:14e0.note: Maps 0 to A, 1 to B, 2 to C, anything else to B

1058:1510.name: ttm_effectOpcode
1058:1510.note: Runs the 0xa014..0xa094 and 0xa0b5 effects with target A (B for the zone 0 restore): zone 0 save and restore, slides, strips, blinds, copies; puts the target back after

1058:1920.name: ttm_effectPause
1058:1920.note: Calls 1058:1949 with an empty rect 100 times (a busy wait)

1058:1949.name: ttm_effectCopy
1058:1949.note: gfx_copyRect when width and height are both above 2

1058:197c.name: ttm_emptyMirrorHook
1058:197c.note: Empty function; TTM opcode 0x2012 calls it

1058:198a.name: ttm_dissolveEffect
1058:198a.note: Opcode 0xa0b5: copies a rect of B to A; with 1068:1ebf set (never) dissolves it pixel by pixel in LFSR order

1058:1ad0.name: ttm_timerExpired
1058:1ad0.note: Returns 1 when a timer record (start, duration) has run out, or when 1068:45e2 is 0

1058:1b1f.name: ttm_timerLerp
1058:1b1f.note: Interpolates between two values by the elapsed share of a timer record

1058:1be1.name: ttm_startTimer
1058:1be1.note: Fills a timer record with the clock 1068:2e70/2e72 and a duration

1058:1c06.name: ttm_expireTimer
1058:1c06.note: Fills a timer record that has already run out; nothing references it

1060:0000.name: gfx_growDirtyPool
1060:0000.note: Allocates ceil(n / 5) * 5 zeroed 26-byte dirty-rect nodes and puts them on the free list 1068:46ee; adds them to the count 1068:46ec

1060:007e.name: gfx_addDirtyRect
1060:007e.note: Adds a dirty rect to the list keyed (source, target, age): kind 1 is cut to the clip or screen, turned into 8-pixel columns, and merged when the union wastes at most 20 cells (16-bit); kind 4 has source -1

1060:03d3.name: gfx_restoreDirtyRects
1060:03d3.note: Replays the source/target pairs of the table at 1068:287e with age 0 (or only 1068:2882), then with 0 ages every remaining node by -1

1060:046e.name: gfx_clearDirtyLists
1060:046e.note: Moves every node of the 20 dirty lists to the free list

1060:04b2.name: gfx_dirtyOverlaps
1060:04b2.note: Returns 1 when a kind-1 node of any list with that target and age overlaps the rect in columns and rows, else 0

1060:0556.name: gfx_freeDirtyPool
1060:0556.note: Empties the lists and frees the node pool blocks; does not reset the pool count

1060:0596.name: gfx_dirtyPoolSize
1060:0596.note: Returns the dirty node pool count 1068:46ec; unreferenced

1060:05a7.name: gfx_findDirtyList
1060:05a7.note: Returns the head slot whose first node has the given source, target, and age, else the first empty slot, else 0

1060:05f9.name: gfx_replayDirtyList
1060:05f9.note: Sets source/target DCs from the head, replays the list head to tail (kind 1: copy 8-pixel columns, kind 4: restore saved bits), then frees it

1060:06ac.name: gfx_dropDirtyList
1060:06ac.note: Frees one dirty list without replaying it

1060:06f5.name: gfx_copyDirtyList
1060:06f5.note: Meant to copy one list into another key; never advances past the head, so it loops forever on a non-empty list; unreferenced

1060:0a23.name: platform_globalAllocLock
1060:0a23.note: GlobalAlloc with size in DX:AX and default flags plus GMEM_MOVEABLE, then GlobalLock

1060:0a53.name: platform_globalUnlockFree
1060:0a53.note: GlobalHandle on a far pointer, then GlobalUnlock and GlobalFree
